steps.note: LOCKED (deliberate auth extension): the unauthenticated probe asserts the daemon's auth gate — 401 {error:{code,message,retryable}} BEFORE any handler effect. The vendored types declare no 401 for global.health (only 400 BadRequestError) and the SDK client always authenticates, so there is no SDK-declared success/error shape this refusal could match; removing the gate is not an option.

LOCKED (no provider-credential backend): the upstream SDK auth surface is provider OAuth at PUT /auth/{providerID}; the daemon has no provider credential store (its /auth/set rotates the SERVER password) and /auth/{providerID} is not registered -> 404. An exact pass would require implementing provider OAuth persistence outside the allowed compat surface; answering the declared 200: boolean would be a fabricated credential write.
